stem.text: The force resisting the motion of a car is proportional to the square of the car’s speed. The magnitude of the force at a speed of $20.0\,\text{m s}^{-1}$ is $800\,\text{N}$.
What useful output power is required from the car’s engine to maintain a steady speed of $40.0\,\text{m s}^{-1}$?
